name: The Standard Group Plc
source: The Standard Group Plc consolidated audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 48: direct costs 567,214; selling and distribution costs 208,472; administrative and operating expenses 1,893,014; net movement in expected credit losses 241,588; finance costs 110,558; earnings per share (13.46)) https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/corporate/assets/reports/SG_ANNUAL_REPORT_2024.pdf ; audited statements for the year ended 31 December 2023 with 2022 comparatives (page 61: direct costs 749,880 / 749,386; other gains (8,489) / 22,749; selling 239,517 / 257,202; administrative 1,971,167 / 2,320,891; expected credit losses 46,167 / 246,323; finance costs 88,743 / 215,676; income tax (538,902) / 158,259; earnings per share (14.27) / (10.05)) https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/corporate/assets/reports/annualreport_2023_v1.pdf ; unaudited group results for the six months ended 30 June 2025 (revenue 789,151; total operating costs (878,820); other income 8,790; finance costs (52,134); loss before tax (133,013); no income tax line) https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/corporate/assets/announcements/unaudited_group_results_for_the_6_month_period_ended_30_june_2025.pdf . All amounts in KES thousands as printed by the issuer. | CRON 2026-11-24: Operating Profit (EBIT) filled for FY2023 and FY2024 from the audited consolidated statements of profit or loss, The Standard Group Plc annual report 2024 page 48, KES 000 scaled by 1,000. The issuer prints no operating profit line, so EBIT is the sum of its printed lines above finance costs: gross profit plus other income or losses, less selling and distribution, administrative and operating expenses, and the net movement in expected credit losses. FY2024 printed lines: revenue 1,843,206; direct costs (567,214); other income 77,885; selling and distribution (208,472); administrative and operating (1,893,014); net movement in ECL (241,588); finance costs (110,558); loss before taxation (1,099,755). FY2023 printed lines: revenue 2,381,425; direct costs (749,880); other gains or losses (8,489); selling and distribution (239,517); administrative (1,971,167); movement in ECL (46,167); finance costs (88,743); loss before taxation (722,538). Ties: 1,275,992 plus 77,885 less 208,472 less 1,893,014 less 241,588 equals (989,197), which less finance costs of 110,558 equals the printed loss before taxation of (1,099,755). 1,631,545 less 8,489 less 239,517 less 1,971,167 less 46,167 equals (633,795), which less 88,743 equals the printed (722,538). Both years reconcile to the shilling. FY2022 is left empty because the 2022 comparative column in the 2023 annual report page 61 does not foot: its printed lines sum to (1,040,666) against a printed loss before taxation of (1,023,463), a 17,203 thousand gap, so no figure is derived from it.
source_note: CRON 20261121: rebuilt from the audited statements so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are no longer blank, and FY2024 earnings per share corrected to the audited (13.46). The three operating cost lines sum exactly to the published total operating costs (2,910,288 for FY2024 and 3,006,731 for FY2023), which confirms the split. The abridged FY2024 announcement printed earnings per share of (12.50) on a different share base; the full audited statements print (13.46) and that is the figure stored. FY2022: the AR2023 comparative column prints revenue 2,726,063 while its own expense lines sum 17,203 more than its printed loss before tax allows, so Operating Expenses for FY2022 is the balancing figure; every printed component is retained in Other Income and Net Finance Costs and both printed totals tie exactly. H1 2025 prints a single total operating costs line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit stay blank for that column rather than being split by assumption. ROE and Debt to Equity are withheld because shareholders equity is negative in every period. No FY2025 audited results are published: the issuer investors page carries no results announcement or annual report after the FY2024 set, so the file is honestly current to the last audited year.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.formula: Gross Profit + Other Income - Operating Expenses; H1 2025 uses Revenue + Other Income - total operating costs because the interim prints one combined cost line
rows.derivedFormula: Printed lines of the issuer statement above finance costs

rows.note: withheld: shareholders equity is negative in every period

filerStatus.source: Nairobi Securities Exchange, 2025 Combined Corporate Calendar, section 2025 Corporate Calendars not Submitted
filerStatus.note: The exchange lists the issuer among companies that did not submit its 2025 corporate calendar. The issuer investor page carries the FY2024 audited results and the half year to 30 June 2025 but no FY2025 audited results announcement as at 22 November 2026, so the statements stop at FY2024.
filerStatus.reasonShort: the annual results for the year to 31 December 2025 had not been published when this data was last checked.
